definitions.explanation: A duration of three hours. Formed with {時間|じかん} (hour, duration) used as a counter after {三|さん}.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{三時間|さんじかん}{近|ちか}くある。
examples.english: This film is nearly three hours long.

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}のせいで、{空港|くうこう}まで{三時間|さんじかん}もかかってしまった。
examples.english: Because of the traffic jam, it took a full three hours to get to the airport.

notes:
{三|さん} (three) + {時間|じかん} (hour, duration). No sound change: さんじかん, not さんじっかん.

DURATION VS. TIME POINT:
- {三時間|さんじかん}: a duration of three hours
- {三時|さんじ}: three o'clock (the time point)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三時間|さんじかん}かかる: to take three hours
- {三時間|さんじかん}{以内|いない}: within three hours
- {三時間|さんじかん}{半|はん}: three and a half hours
- {三時間|さんじかん}{待|ま}つ: to wait three hours

RELATED WORDS:
- {一時間|いちじかん}: one hour
- {二時間|にじかん}: two hours
